# Tailwind CSS

> Tailwind CSS v4.3 — a utility-first CSS framework. You build UI by composing utility classes in markup; the framework compiles exactly the CSS you use. In v4, configuration is **CSS-first** (`@theme`), content is auto-detected, and builds are handled by a Vite plugin.
>
> Latest docs: https://tailwindcss.com/docs · Latest version: v4.3 (release v4.3.3) · GitHub: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss · Releases: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.3.3
>
> **Verification note (2026-08-04):** this index was built from the live docs navigation at tailwindcss.com/docs (203 URLs) and cross-checked with HTTP status probes. Tailwind publishes no `sitemap.xml` (404) and no official `llms.txt`.

## How this repo uses it (Farming Game client)

- Version: `tailwindcss ^4.3.0`, `@tailwindcss/vite ^4.3.0`, plus plugins `@tailwindcss/forms` and `@tailwindcss/typography` (client).
- Vite plugin registered in `client/vite.config.ts` (`tailwindcss()` from `@tailwindcss/vite`).
- Single CSS entry: `client/src/routes/layout.css`:

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
@plugin '@tailwindcss/forms';
@plugin '@tailwindcss/typography';
```

- There is **no `tailwind.config.js`** — configuration lives in CSS (see `@theme` below).

## Key v4 concepts (hand-built reference)

### Installation with Vite

```bash
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
```

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
// add to the plugin array: tailwindcss()
```

```css
/* your CSS entry */
@import "tailwindcss";
```

### CSS-first configuration — `@theme`

v4 has no config file by default. Customize the design system with `@theme` in CSS. Every `--token` becomes a CSS variable **and** generates utilities:

```css
@theme {
  --color-brand: oklch(0.5 0.2 250);        /* bg-brand, text-brand, border-brand… */
  --font-display: "Inter", sans-serif;      /* font-display */
  --spacing: 0.25rem;                        /* spacing scale base (dynamic) */
  --breakpoint-xs: 30rem;                    /* new responsive variant xs: */
}
```

Reference tokens in your own CSS with `var(--color-brand)`. v4's default palette uses the **oklch** color space.

### Custom utilities — `@utility`

```css
@utility text-shadow-lg {
  text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);
}
/* usage: <div class="text-shadow-lg"> */
```

### Custom variants — `@variant` / `@custom-variant`

```css
@variant pointer-coarse (@media (pointer: coarse));

/* class-based dark mode (instead of default prefers-color-scheme): */
@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));
```

### Dark mode

By default `dark:` follows `prefers-color-scheme`. For a class/toggle-based dark mode, add `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));` in your CSS, then toggle `class="dark"` on `<html>` and use `dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white`.

### Variants and stacking

- **Responsive** (mobile-first): `sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, `xl:`, `2xl:`; also `max-sm:` and arbitrary `min-[...]:` / `max-[...]:`.
- **State**: `hover:`, `focus:`, `focus-visible:`, `active:`, `disabled:`, `visited:`, `checked:`, `required:`, `invalid:`, `placeholder-shown:`, `selection:`.
- **Structural**: `first:`, `last:`, `odd:`, `even:`, `only:`, `not-*:`.
- **Group/peer**: `group-hover:`, `group-focus-within:`, `group-data-[...]:`, `peer-checked:`, etc.
- **Other**: `aria-*:`, `data-[...]:`, `*:` (children), `&:` (self), `motion-safe:`, `motion-reduce:`, `print:`, `portrait:`, `landscape:`, `rtl:`, `ltr:`.
- **Container queries** (built in): mark a parent `@container`, then use `@sm:`, `@md:`, `@min-[...]:`, `@max-[...]:`.
- Variants **stack**: `hover:focus:bg-…`.

### Color / alpha modifiers

```html
<div class="bg-black/50 text-red-500/75">…</div>  <!-- /0–100, or /50% -->
```

### Reusing styles — `@apply`

```css
.btn { @apply inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-semibold; }
```

Use sparingly (prefer utility classes in markup). In separate CSS files (not the entry), import the theme without emitting utilities via `@reference`:

```css
@reference "layout.css";
.btn { @apply …; }
```

### Explicit content sources — `@source`

Content is auto-detected. Only add `@source` when a file path is missed:

```css
@source "../node_modules/@farminggame/…";
```

### Functions & directives summary

| Directive | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `@import "tailwindcss"` | Single entry (includes Preflight reset + utilities) |
| `@theme { … }` | Define design tokens → CSS variables + utilities |
| `@utility name { … }` | Custom utility |
| `@variant` / `@custom-variant` | Custom variant / redefine a built-in variant |
| `@apply …` | Inline existing utilities in your CSS |
| `@reference "file.css"` | Import theme/tokens into a separate file without emitting utilities |
| `@source "…"` | Explicit content scan path |
| `@config "tailwind.config.js"` | Load a legacy v3-style config (migration) |

`theme()` is legacy in v4 — use `var(--token)` instead.

### Notable v4 utilities

`text-balance`, `text-pretty`, `outline-hidden`, `field-sizing-content`, dynamic viewport units (`h-dvh`, `min-h-dvh`), subgrid (`grid-cols-subgrid`, `col-span-subgrid`), and a fully **dynamic spacing scale** (any value works: `mt-17`, `w-29`, `p-[13px]`).

---

### Plugins (used in this repo)
- `@tailwindcss/forms` — form-element styling, installed via `@plugin '@tailwindcss/forms'`. Repo: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms
- `@tailwindcss/typography` — `prose` classes, installed via `@plugin '@tailwindcss/typography'`. Repo: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-typography
